blocks.text: Following the failed first attempt to move the ark (recounted in 1 Chronicles 13), David now brings the ark to Jerusalem using the correct prescribed order. The Levites carry it according to proper procedure and place it in a tent David had prepared. With the ark properly installed at Jerusalem's center, David establishes continuing worship before it as the central religious practice of his reign.

sections.title: Appointment of Priestly and Musical Service

blocks.text: David appoints specific Levites to maintain regular worship service before the ark according to prescribed order. Asaph is designated chief musician, heading an ensemble of musicians with lyres and harps. Two priests, Benaiah and Jahaziel, are assigned to sound trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant. This formal assignment ensures sustained, organized worship at the ark's location.
